title: Trump Hints at Iran Deal Amid Halted Attacks
summary: US President Donald Trump said on August 1 that the US was ready to strike Iran but had asked Tehran and other West Asian countries not to attack. The US has paused its military strikes against Iran amid a diplomatic push for a peace deal in the region. Trump claimed that the 'perimeters of a deal' had been agreed upon, but it is unclear what this entails. The US has been working with allies to finalize a peace deal in the Middle East. The Iranian government has denied making any requests to the US not to strike Iran.
summary_points: The US President Donald Trump said on August 1 that the US was ready to strike Iran but had asked Tehran and other West Asian countries not to attack.
